using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests.Commands
{
    public class TranslateCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ExecuteAsync_TranslateOnline_LogsInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TranslateCommand>>();
            var command = new TranslateCommand(loggerMock.Object);
            var args = new CommandLineArgs
            {
                Options = new Dictionary<string, string>
                {
                    { "--online", "" },
                    { "--culture", "fr" },
                    { "--reference-culture", "en" },
                    { "--deep-l-auth-key", "auth-key" }
                }
            };

            // Act
            await command.ExecuteAsync(args);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(logger => logger.LogInformation(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Args
{
    public class CommandLineArgs
    {
        public Dictionary<string, string> Options { get; } = new Dictionary<string, string>();

        public string[] NonOptionArgs { get; set; }

        public string GetOrNull(string shortName, string longName)
        {
            if (Options.TryGetValue(longName, out var value))
            {
                return value;
            }

            if (Options.TryGetValue(shortName, out value))
            {
                return value;
            }

            return null;
        }

        public bool ContainsKey(string shortName, string longName)
        {
            return Options.ContainsKey(longName) || Options.ContainsKey(shortName);
        }
    }
}
